name: @fractalai/stablecoin-receipt-issuer
description: Issuer (library + CLI) of latam-stablecoin-receipt: a post-quantum (ML-DSA-65 / FIPS 204) receipt for an ERC-20 Transfer of a pinned Latin-American stablecoin that already happened on-chain. Reads the Transfer from public RPCs, never from the requester; signs with an operator-supplied key; emits only what the Trust Kernel accepts. Spec: spec/TRUST-KERNEL.md §12.
